A functional machine learning workflow emphasizes explicit verbs, stable objects, and reproducible transitions between modeling steps.

## Design principle

The main idea is to keep the workflow readable:

```r
fit()
evaluate()
tune()
compare_learners()
interpret()
estimate()
```

Each verb should return an object with a clear class, predictable print and summary methods, and enough metadata to reproduce the analysis.

## Why it matters

For applied health data science, the modeling interface should make validation, tuning, comparison, and interpretation visible. A compact functional interface can reduce friction while preserving statistical transparency.

## Boundary

Preprocessing should remain explicit and separate from model fitting. This makes it easier to audit transformations and avoid hidden data leakage.
